why: Both sides use the same 𝓑 (detBasis_eq, with the glue of V6_25). A (proposition_6_23, universes 0) says 𝓑 is a topological basis of the project's topology 𝒯, the total-space topology of detPrebundle. B says 𝓑 is a basis of generateFrom 𝓑. A ⇒ B uses A: IsTopologicalBasis.eq_generateFrom gives 𝒯 = generateFrom 𝓑. B ⇒ A holds only outright (B unused), by re-running the project's proof. A also identifies the topology generated by 𝓑 with the prebundle topology 𝒯, so the text's topology is Mathlib's fibre-bundle topology. That identification is the whole content of the project's proof: each set of 𝓑 is 𝒯-open via the prebundle trivializations, and every 𝒯-open set is a union of sets of 𝓑. B speaks only of generateFrom 𝓑 and cannot supply it. This is a real strengthening beyond the text's 'basis for a topology', not missing glue.
overlap: A_to_B and B_to_A each share 314 project theorems. These are the body of detPrebundle (Lemma 6.25 and the lemma_6_21 / corollary_6_13 / Proposition 6.12 machinery), reached through the topology instance in A's statement, plus the chart API. B_to_A also reuses the steps of the project's own proof (trivializationOfMemPretrivializationAtlas, localDetChartAt, mem_baseSet_localDetChartAt).
